title: AIS Cluster Values
description: Schema for configuring ais-cluster Helm Chart. Contains required and optional values, with examples and descriptions.

servicePort.description: Deprecated by operator >= 4.0.0 and required by earlier versions. Use portPublic for the port the daemon binds, and proxySpec.externalAccess.loadBalancer.port for the port a proxy LoadBalancer publishes.

affinity.description: Scheduling constraints for the daemon pods, in core Kubernetes Affinity format.

autoScale.description: Tuning for auto-scaling, applied when size is -1.

sizeLimit.description: Upper bound on the number of pods when auto-scaling.

maxUnavailable.description: Number of pods allowed to be unavailable while auto-scaling. Defaults to 0.

probeSpec.description: Timing overrides for one probe. HTTP endpoints and ports are managed by the operator.

probes.description: Health probe timing overrides for the AIS daemon container. Unset probes use operator defaults.

pvcRetentionPolicy.description: StatefulSet PVC retention policy for the daemon. Honored by default on Kubernetes >= 1.27 and stable in 1.32.

annotations.description: Annotations to attach to the AIStore CR.

size.description: Number of nodes in the AIS cluster. Set to -1 to auto-scale to the nodes matching proxySpec.nodeSelector and targetSpec.nodeSelector.

storageClass.description: Storage class defined in K8s cluster, used for AIS mounts.

size.description: Size of the storage mount. Must be parsable as a k8s resource.Quantity.

useHostPath.description: Mount storage directly from host paths instead of using PersistentVolumes. When true, storageClass and size are not needed.

pvSelector.description: Add a label selector to each target PVC so it binds only to a matching pre-labeled PV. Defaults to true. Set false when binding to PVs created by a provisioner such as local-static-provisioner, which does not carry the mpath label.

mounts.description: List of mountpath entries for each target. Each entry has a 'path' and optional 'label'.

label.description: Optional label for disk mapping and grouping

protocol.description: Protocol to use for public endpoint.

tls.description: TLS configuration options (only applies if protocol is https). Specify only one of: secretName or certificate.

skipVerifyCert.description: Skip TLS certificate verification (useful for self-signed certs in testing).

secretName.description: Name of an existing Kubernetes secret containing TLS cert/key.

issuerRef.description: Reference to a cert-manager Issuer or ClusterIssuer.

name.description: Name of the cert-manager Issuer or ClusterIssuer.

mode.description: Certificate delivery mode: 'secret' (shared) or 'csi' (per-pod via CSI driver). Defaults to 'secret'. In 'csi' mode, node-derived SANs are not auto-included; use additionalDNSNames or hostnameMap.

additionalDNSNames.description: Extra DNS names to include in the certificate.

renewBefore.description: When to start renewing (default: 720h = 30 days before expiry).

imagePullSecrets.description: Array of secrets to use when authenticating with registry for image pulls

initImage.description: Init container image for AIS preparation on startup.

tag.description: Image tag for the init container. Should usually be kept in sync with NodeImage

logSidecar.description: Optional sidecar container for log collection and shipping.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the log sidecar container.

cloud.description: Optional cloud secrets for backend providers.

awsSecretName.description: Name of Kubernetes secret for AWS credentials.

gcpSecretName.description: Name of Kubernetes secret for GCP credentials.

ociSecretName.description: Name of Kubernetes secret for OCI credentials.

apiMode.description: Mode for the operator to use when communicating with this cluster. Optional, defaults to using internal K8s service

clusterDomain.description: Removed in operator 4.0.0 and applies only to earlier versions. Kubernetes cluster DNS domain, defaulting to cluster.local with operator versions < 3.4. Later versions use the cluster domain the operator is configured with or discovers at startup.

configToUpdate.description: Update the AIS config directly in spec. See https://github.com/NVIDIA/ais-k8s/blob/main/operator/api/aistore/v1beta1/aisconfig.go for valid options

hostnameMap.description: Map node hostnames to the second IP to use.

shutdownCluster.description: Shut down the cluster (dangerous: scales down all pods).

stateStorage.description: AIStore state storage configuration. Exactly one of hostPath, pvc, or emptyDir should be set.

prefix.description: Path on node for pod hostPath state volumes.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for dynamically provisioning state/config volumes.

emptyDir.description: Ephemeral emptyDir volume for AIStore state. State is lost on pod restart.

hostpathPrefix.description: Rejected by operator >= 4.0.0 on cluster creation and on any spec update. Use stateStorage.hostPath.prefix.

stateStorageClass.description: Rejected by operator >= 4.0.0 on cluster creation and on any spec update. Use stateStorage.pvc.storageClass.

cleanupData.description: Delete all data on cluster removal.

cleanupMetadata.description: Delete all cluster metadata on removal, including state PVCs.

authNSecretName.description: Kubernetes secret for the AIS authN server credentials.

auth.description: Auth specifies the Auth service configuration for admin authentication.

profileRef.description: ProfileRef references the cluster-scoped AIStoreAuthProfile holding the auth provider configuration (operator >= 3.3.0). When set, the remaining auth fields are ignored. The submitting user must have 'use' access to the referenced profile.

name.description: Name of the AIStoreAuthProfile to use for fetching AIS tokens.

serviceURL.description: Removed in operator 4.0.0 and applies only to earlier versions. Use profileRef to reference an existing AIStoreAuthProfile. See https://github.com/NVIDIA/ais-k8s/blob/main/docs/auth_profile.md. ServiceURL is the base URL of the AuthN service (scheme + host + optional port, no path). Defaults to 'http://ais-authn.ais:52001'.

usernamePassword.description: Removed in operator 4.0.0 and applies only to earlier versions. Use profileRef to reference an existing AIStoreAuthProfile. See https://github.com/NVIDIA/ais-k8s/blob/main/docs/auth_profile.md. UsernamePassword authentication configuration using static credentials.

secretName.description: SecretName is the name of the secret containing AuthN admin credentials (SU-NAME and SU-PASS).

secretNamespace.description: SecretNamespace is the namespace of the secret containing AuthN admin credentials. If not specified, defaults to the AIStore cluster namespace.

tokenExchange.description: Removed in operator 4.0.0 and applies only to earlier versions. Use profileRef to reference an existing AIStoreAuthProfile. See https://github.com/NVIDIA/ais-k8s/blob/main/docs/auth_profile.md. TokenExchange authentication configuration using RFC 8693 OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange.

tokenPath.description: TokenPath is the path to the token used for exchange. Operator versions 3.3 and below default to '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token'. Newer versions mint a new token.

tokenExchangeEndpoint.description: TokenExchangeEndpoint is the AuthN endpoint for token exchange. Defaults to '/token'.

operatorSkipVerifyCrt.description: Controls TLS certificate verification for Operator -> AIS HTTPS calls. False enforces verification; true disables it. If unset, operator fallback behavior applies.

enableExternalLB.description: Removed in operator 4.0.0 and applies only to earlier versions. Enables operator-managed LoadBalancer services for proxies and targets. Use proxySpec.externalAccess and/or targetSpec.externalAccess.

publicNetDNSMode.description: Defines the public network DNS name to use with hostPort. Defaults to 'IP' to use the host IP.

logsDir.description: Logs directory on host to store AIS logs, mounted as a HostPath volume.

issuerCAConfigMap.description: ConfigMap holding the CA bundle used to verify OIDC issuer certificates. Must contain a 'ca.crt' key with the bundle in PEM format.

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass for proxy and target pods. A high priority class prevents eviction during node pressure.

tracingTokenSecretName.description: Kubernetes secret containing the OTEL trace-exporter token.

size.description: Number of proxy pods to deploy. If not set, uses cluster size. Set to -1 to auto-scale to the nodes matching proxySpec.nodeSelector.

annotations.description: Annotations to attach to proxy pods.

labels.description: Labels to attach to proxy pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling proxies. Omit to use default: nvidia.com/ais-proxy=<cluster name>.

sysctls.description: Custom sysctls for the proxy pod. Unsafe sysctls require kubelet allow-list.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits block. Example format matches core Kubernetes resource definitions.

externalAccess.description: Configuration for cluster-external access to proxies, currently via a shared LoadBalancer.

loadBalancer.description: Tuning for the shared proxy LoadBalancer service.

port.description: Port the proxy LoadBalancer service listens on. Defaults to proxySpec.portPublic.

size.description: Number of target pods to deploy. If not set, uses cluster size. Set to -1 to auto-scale to the nodes matching targetSpec.nodeSelector.

annotations.description: Annotations to attach to target pods.

labels.description: Labels to attach to target pods.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling target pods. Omit to use default: nvidia.com/ais-proxy=<your cluster>

sysctls.description: Custom sysctls for the target pod. Unsafe sysctls require kubelet allow-list.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits block for target pods.

hostNetwork.description: Set to true to run pods with host networking enabled.

pdb.description: PodDisruptionBudget configuration for target pods. When enabled, the operator creates a PDB to protect target pods from voluntary evictions during node drain or cluster scale-down.

enabled.description: Controls whether a PodDisruptionBudget is created for target pods.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number of target pods that can be unavailable during voluntary disruptions. Can be an absolute number (e.g. 1) or a percentage (e.g. '10%'). Setting to 0 prevents any voluntary evictions. Defaults to 0.

scaleDownMode.description: Controls how targets are scaled down (operator >= 3.2.0). safe_decommission (default) rebalances then removes the target while keeping on-disk data; decommission rebalances then removes the target and deletes on-disk data; retain puts the target into maintenance mode for immediate reschedule on the same node.

disablePodAntiAffinity.description: Allow more than one target pod to be scheduled on the same Kubernetes node.

externalAccess.description: Configuration for cluster-external access to targets, currently via per-target LoadBalancer services.

enabled.description: Deprecated: Enable a shared proxy LoadBalancer. With operator >= 3.1.0, prefer proxySpec.externalAccess.

port.description: External port for the AIS proxy LoadBalancer service.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the AIS proxy LoadBalancer service.

adminClient.description: Optional admin client deployment. Deploys pre-configured with the cluster endpoint, CLI, Python SDK, and aisloader.

enabled.description: Controls whether the admin client deployment is created. Defaults to true when adminClient is specified.

image.description: Container image for the admin client.

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the admin client container.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the admin client container.

annotations.description: Annotations to apply to the admin client pod.

labels.description: Labels to apply to the admin client pod in addition to defaults.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for admin client scheduling.

affinity.description: Affinity scheduling rules for the admin client.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the admin client pod.

env.description: Additional environment variables for the admin client container.

caConfigMap.description: ConfigMap containing the CA bundle for TLS trust. When specified, the ConfigMap is mounted and AIS_CLIENT_CA is set.

name.description: Name of the ConfigMap containing the CA bundle.

key.description: Key within the ConfigMap containing the CA certificate bundle in PEM format.
